'''Funglet''' is a [[Grass]] type [[Support]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Trippet]] at 6 bronze stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "Funglet dreams of curling up in a dark, damp corner and sleeping until the end of the world. It'll also be the end of the world for anyone who dares to disturb that sleep."

Funglet is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
TBA

== Evolution Trial ==
Funglet's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Trippet]] you need to complete the following task:
* Log in for 2 days in a row.

==Trivia==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Give Funglet some space or the whole camp will go on a trippy adventure on a magic school bus."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Interacting with other Tatari drains energy, so Funglet prefers staying alone in corners and shows little interest in combat."
